name: Job hunter guard
description: Trusted tool policy for the jobhunter-* agents, browser result observer, exec environment, heartbeat and the owner-only /jh chat command.

repo.description: Absolute path of the openclaw-job-hunter clone (no spaces).

python.description: Absolute path of the python3 interpreter the agents must use in exec calls.

homeFile.description: Absolute path of private/home.json of this install.

publicReadonlyAgents.description: Agents outside jobhunter-* that may run the public read-only jh.py commands (status, inbox, approvals list, budget, breaker status, home show).

ownerFallback.description: Chat senders accepted as the owner for /jh when the host does not report owner status.

claudeNativeTools.description: Claude Code native tools of jobhunter agents: deny (default; restricted runs never offer them) or gate (the reduced-protection mode N only).

pinToolSurface.description: before_prompt_build narrows every jobhunter run to its ACL tools and gives a run not started by cron the G_STRAY_RUN notice (default true).

proofCarriers.description: Where the agent identity proof goes: the --agent-proof argv rewrite, the resolve_exec_env JH_AGENT_PROOF, or both (default both).

recordEvents.description: Write logs/guard-events-<yyyymmdd>.jsonl with redacted call shapes (test profiles only; default false).

protectedRoots.description: Absolute folders other agents may not read (read) or write (write); private/ and the repo are always protected.

qcVerdictFile.description: Fallback F-QC: jobhunter-qc may write its verdict file under work/verdict/ (default false).
